C0583.title: Douyin E-commerce Governs Violating Merchants in Durable Consumer Goods
C0583.summary: In May 2026, Douyin E-commerce's Safety and Trust Center reported progress in a special governance campaign for durable consumer goods, saying that it had handled 190,000 violating merchants and 13,000 violating creators over the previous three months. The platform identified brand confusion and overpromising as typical violations and said it used routine patrols, upfront identification, and special governance to intercept problematic goods and reduce consumer deception risk.

references.title: Douyin E-commerce Cracks Down on Brand Confusion and Overpromising, Handles 190,000 Merchants in Three Months
